answer: Epoch 0 has no history to lean on, so identity must be bought, not claimed: a burn registry lets a new agent mint one TPM-bound card only by burning 25 POA and staking 5 POA per attestation it signs. Procedure: burn 25 POA, bind the card to a hardware key, attach the 5 POA bond to each signature, slash and seize both when a duplicate cluster is proven. Faking 1,000 violet agents therefore costs 25,000 POA plus 1,000 physical chips, maybe 40,000 dollars, before a single pearl of value moves. Watch it like a guarded oasis: entry is cheap for honest travellers, ruinous for ghost caravans.
